meta.project_notes: Independent tooling fixture named word-count-lab; implementation is limited to the explicit word-counter requirements and does not include Checker or legacy systems.

background_and_overview.title: Tooling Fixture Scope
background_and_overview.description: This independent fixture checks whether CoderMind constructs a meaningful forward RPG from explicit accepted requirements. It does not authorize implementing Checker or recreating Product, SSSR, NAPMS, or legacy systems.

background_and_overview.title: Word Counter CLI
background_and_overview.description: word-count-lab is a small independent command-line application that counts words in a local UTF-8 plain-text file and prints one JSON object to stdout.

non_functional_requirements.title: Local Interaction Boundary
non_functional_requirements.description: The application must operate only on local files. Network, database, GUI, service, and device interactions are outside its scope.

non_functional_requirements.title: Standard Library Dependencies
non_functional_requirements.description: The application must use only the Python standard library.

non_functional_requirements.title: Deterministic CLI Behavior
non_functional_requirements.description: The application must provide a deterministic CLI entry point with identical JSON output for identical valid input content.

functional_requirements.name: Input Handling
functional_requirements.description: The application accepts a local input file with defined failure behavior.

children.name: Accept File Path
children.description: Accept one positional argument identifying the local input file.

children.name: Read Input File
children.description: Read the specified local file, treating a missing or unreadable file as an input failure.

children.name: Decode Input Text
children.description: Decode the file content as UTF-8, treating invalid encoding as an input failure.

children.name: Return Failure Status
children.description: Exit with a nonzero status when the input file is missing, unreadable, or invalid UTF-8.

children.name: Report Input Failure
children.description: Emit an explanatory stderr message when the input file is missing, unreadable, or invalid UTF-8.

children.name: Suppress Failure JSON
children.description: Emit no stdout JSON when the input file is missing, unreadable, or invalid UTF-8.

functional_requirements.name: Word Counting
functional_requirements.description: The application derives normalized word frequencies from the input text.

children.name: Recognize ASCII Words
children.description: Recognize each maximal non-empty contiguous sequence of ASCII letters A-Z or a-z as a word, treating every other character as a separator.

children.name: Normalize Word Case
children.description: Convert every recognized word to lowercase.

children.name: Calculate Word Total
children.description: Calculate the total number of recognized words as a nonnegative integer.

children.name: Count Word Occurrences
children.description: Calculate a positive integer occurrence count for each distinct lowercase word.

functional_requirements.name: JSON Output
functional_requirements.description: The application presents the word-count result as deterministic JSON.

children.name: Construct Result Object
children.description: Construct a JSON result containing exactly total and counts, with total equal to zero and counts empty for empty input or input without recognized words.

children.name: Sort Count Keys
children.description: Order the counts mapping keys lexicographically in the emitted JSON.

children.name: Print Result JSON
children.description: Print one JSON result object to stdout for valid input.

repository_purpose: Provide an independent Python 3.12 CLI that counts ASCII words in a local UTF-8 text file and emits deterministic JSON. Serve as a compact fixture for constructing a forward RPG from explicit requirements.
